Star Wars: Shatterpoint

Shatterpoint is a squad-based skirmish game where each player commands a small team of named Star Wars characters. The 40mm scale was chosen specifically to capture high-resolution detail while providing large, smooth surfaces ideal for painters practicing blending techniques.

Scale Details

Miniature Scale
40mm
Ratio Equivalent
1:43
Measurement
eye level
Eye Level Height
40.0mm

At 40mm, Shatterpoint miniatures are the largest standard Star Wars game scale. Atomic Mass Games chose this size to give painters expansive surfaces for blending and highlighting — a deliberate departure from the smaller scales used in Legion and MCP. Characters like Dooku measure approximately 42.75mm total height.

Publisher: Atomic Mass Games · Base Sizes: 40mm, 50mm

3D Printing Tips for Shatterpoint

The large, smooth surfaces of Shatterpoint minis reward fine layer heights — print at 0.04-0.06mm on resin for best results. FDM at 0.08mm is acceptable for terrain pieces. The bigger scale means more material per model, so factor resin usage into your cost calculations. Orient helmets and faces carefully to minimize support marks on visible areas.

Frequently Asked Questions

What scale is Star Wars: Shatterpoint?
Star Wars: Shatterpoint miniatures are 40mm scale (1:43 ratio), measured eye level. At 40mm, Shatterpoint miniatures are the largest standard Star Wars game scale. Atomic Mass Games chose this size to give painters expansive surfaces for blending and highlighting — a deliberate departure from the smaller scales used in Legion and MCP. Characters like Dooku measure approximately 42.75mm total height.
What base sizes does Star Wars: Shatterpoint use?
Star Wars: Shatterpoint uses the following base sizes: 40mm, 50mm.
What nozzle and layer height should I use for Star Wars: Shatterpoint miniatures?
The large, smooth surfaces of Shatterpoint minis reward fine layer heights — print at 0.04-0.06mm on resin for best results. FDM at 0.08mm is acceptable for terrain pieces. The bigger scale means more material per model, so factor resin usage into your cost calculations. Orient helmets and faces carefully to minimize support marks on visible areas.
